title: Exact colimit-preserving evaluation at an affine weakly contractible object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on this site, and let $W\to X$ be an affine site object which is weakly contractible: every epimorphism $F\to G$ of sheaves of sets induces a surjection $F(W)\to G(W)$. Then evaluation $\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R(W))$, $M\mapsto M(W)$, on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is exact and preserves all small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. In particular, for every small filtered diagram $(M_i)$, its canonical comparison $\varinjlim_i M_i(W)\to(\varinjlim_i M_i)(W)$ is an isomorphism, natural in diagrams.
